faqs.question: What is HyroTrader?
faqs.answer: HyroTrader is a crypto-only proprietary trading firm based in Bratislava, Slovakia. It was among the first evaluation firms to route live fills through a real exchange API (Bybit) rather than a legacy FX CFD book. Account sizes run from $5,000 to $200,000 with scaling advertised up to $1,000,000 USDT.

seo.title: What is HyroTrader? | Crypto Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: HyroTrader is a Slovakia-based crypto prop firm with real Bybit API execution and USDT/USDC payouts.

faqs.question: How fast are HyroTrader payouts?
faqs.answer: The first payout can be requested one day after the first funded trade once you have at least $100 of profit. HyroTrader pays USDT or USDC only, typically within 12–24 hours. The evaluation fee is refunded on the first funded payout. Watch the per-payout percentage cap.

seo.title: HyroTrader Payout Speed and Methods
seo.metaDescription: HyroTrader pays USDT/USDC on demand from $100, usually within 12–24 hours, with a fee refund on first payout.

faqs.question: Does HyroTrader use real exchange execution?
faqs.answer: Yes. The primary route is Bybit's live order book via API, so spreads and depth match a personal Bybit account. Traders who cannot use Bybit can trade on CLEO, which uses Binance liquidity. Both books run 24/7.

seo.title: HyroTrader Bybit and CLEO Execution
seo.metaDescription: HyroTrader fills on Bybit's real order book or on CLEO with Binance liquidity, not a CFD crypto feed.

faqs.question: What rules can breach a HyroTrader account?
faqs.answer: 1-Step evaluations use a 10% profit target with a trailing daily loss around 4% and 6% max drawdown. 2-Step is 10% then 5% with a 5% trailing daily and 10% static max. A stop-loss must be placed shortly after every trade. A 40% profit-distribution / consistency rule applies during evaluation only.

seo.title: HyroTrader Evaluation Rules
seo.metaDescription: HyroTrader enforces trailing daily loss, max drawdown, and a mandatory stop-loss on every trade.

faqs.question: What profit split does HyroTrader pay?
faqs.answer: Funded traders start at 80% and can scale to 90% under the published scaling plan. Payouts are crypto-only — there is no bank-wire option.

seo.title: HyroTrader Profit Split
seo.metaDescription: HyroTrader pays 80% on funded accounts, scaling to 90%, in USDT or USDC only.
